rationale.org-governance: Defines enterprise policies, roles, auditing, accountability, and lifecycle governance.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Operationalizes EU AI Act, NIST, privacy, documentation, and audit requirements.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Advocates regex filters, schema validation, policy tests, and deterministic gates.
rationale.ai-review: Uses probabilistic classifiers and evaluators to judge safety, fairness, and factuality.
rationale.risk-routing: Classification scores route high-risk or ambiguous outputs to expert reviewers.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Human experts adjudicate flagged outputs and can withhold unsafe responses.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Source citations, dashboards, and trace logs support human understanding and judgment.
